findings.explanation: The request requires a job to use its own selection rule. It does not establish that this rule is deterministic; a legitimate rule could choose among workers by load or randomness. Own-rule isolation alone also does not prove all output consistency. These statements become additional acceptance obligations in the capture draft and proposed code acceptance.
findings.action: Require own-rule use and absence of cross-job rule leakage. Describe consistency specifically as eliminating inconsistency caused by the wrong rule; ask about deterministic selection only if it is a genuine requested outcome.

evidence: 我的建議是用實際發佈日。你若不確定,就用今天。
findings.explanation: Offering today merely because the real release date is unknown can turn a requested factual correction into a knowingly unverified date. This is advice in an interview, not an observed incorrect edit; the open question and draft still seek the correct date.
findings.action: Keep the exact date unresolved until supplied or supported by release evidence; do not recommend today as a substitute for uncertainty.

findings.category: reader-facing jargon, proportionality and state clarity
evidence: 我已經確認了意圖,但還沒有建立任何檔案,也沒有改動日期。這需要你確認。
findings.explanation: The core requirements are understandable, but essential authorization consequences use unexplained workflow terms such as Ready PR, push and closing-review. Familiar date-only requests receive substantial workflow bookkeeping before resolving their one missing fact. code-4 also opens with a claim of confirmed intent while later saying confirmation is pending. No specific format is required; tables and prose both work.
findings.action: Lead with the requirement and missing fact, describe authorization in plain words (upload branch and open a pull request ready for review), and keep workflow labels secondary. Use one consistent pending-confirmation status. Remove redundant bookkeeping on simple requests.

limits: This is a six-case, one-turn blind evaluation of supplied replies, tool-call inputs and draft strings only; no source skills, plans, prior verdicts or repository artifacts were read.
Tool-call presence is evidence of an attempted action, not successful execution. Tool outputs, hidden kickoff-default contents, complete git status and subsequent user responses are unavailable.
All observed trajectories stop before confirmation, commit and publication. This does not establish behavior after a future user confirmation.
The packet can establish missing-information interviews and draft presence/absence, but not full compliance with an unseen workflow contract.
No global pass is assigned. Not-observed dimensions include successful check execution where outputs are absent and any post-confirmation action.
